findings.description:
Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#279-293):
	External calls:
	- ! m_txs[_h].to.call.value(m_txs[_h].value)(m_txs[_h].data) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#285)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- delete m_txs[_h] (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#290)
	WalletLibrary.m_txs (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#405) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- WalletLibrary.clearPending() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#369-380)
	- WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#279-293)
	- WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#241-266)
WalletLibrary.kill(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#233-235) allows anyone to destruct the contract
WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32).created (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#281) is a local variable never initialized
WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes).created (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#245) is a local variable never initialized
Modifier WalletLibrary.onlymanyowners(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#97-100) does not always execute _; or revert
Modifier WalletLibrary.onlyowner() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#90-93) does not always execute _; or revert

Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#279-293):
	External calls:
	- ! m_txs[_h].to.call.value(m_txs[_h].value)(m_txs[_h].data) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#285)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- MultiTransact(msg.sender,_h,m_txs[_h].value,m_txs[_h].to,m_txs[_h].data,created) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#289)

Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#241-266):
	External calls:
	- ! _to.call.value(_value)(_data) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#249)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- SingleTransact(msg.sender,_value,_to,_data,created) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#252)

WalletLibrary.underLimit(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#351-364) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- today() > m_lastDay (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_023.sol#353)
